campaign.name: Beat the surface code at k=25, weight-6, 2D bilayer

direction.hypothesis: A bilayer weight-6 code can beat the cell frontier entry 190-20-8 (k=20, d=8, n=190, kd^2/n=6.7) on kd^2/n; target kd^2/n > 6.7 (e.g. d>=9 at k=20, n=200, or d>=13 at k=30, n=700).

bar.note: Cell frontier entry (exact distance; certs/190-20-8.json); bilayer weight-6 cell already has 36 entries at k 20..30.

direction.feasibility: Bilayer weight-6 cell has headroom; existing BB families reach this regime.

novelty.claim: Extend the bilayer weight-6 frontier beyond (k=20,d=8,n=190) / (k=26,d=7,n=234); not the first systematic k~25 probe in this cell.
novelty.against: Existing local-2d-bilayer weight-6 entries, including 190-20-8 and 234-26-7.

direction.expected_value: A bilayer weight-6 code on the cell frontier at kd^2/n > 6.7 would extend multi-logical 2D results.
direction.what_a_negative_would_teach: Whether weight-6 bilayer constructions can reach k~25, or whether locality caps the cell.
